# wpar -- one row per country joining or leaving a war.
#
# Replaces balance_wpar_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 31,705 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="wpar_obj"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (6), each a map of its own:
#     obj      <- scope:wpar_war
#     c        <- scope:wpar_c
#     d        <- global_var:wpar_date
#     k        <- global_var:wpar_kind
#     s        <- global_var:wpar_side
#     a        <- global_var:wpar_base
#
# global_var:wpar_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

wpar_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = wpar_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = wpar_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = wpar_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_obj key = global_var:wpar_count value = scope:wpar_war }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_c key = global_var:wpar_count value = scope:wpar_c }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_d key = global_var:wpar_count value = global_var:wpar_date }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_k key = global_var:wpar_count value = global_var:wpar_kind }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_s key = global_var:wpar_count value = global_var:wpar_side }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = wpar_a key = global_var:wpar_count value = global_var:wpar_base }
}
